cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Helix

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Curved outer rim of the auricle formed by elastic cartilage covered by skin.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Forms the outer superior and posterior border of the auricle.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Scapha

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Narrow depression between the helix and antihelix.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Runs parallel to the helix along the upper auricle.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Antihelix

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Curved cartilaginous ridge lying anterior and roughly parallel to the helix.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Superiorly divides into the crura of the antihelix.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Crus of antihelix

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: One of the superior branches of the antihelix.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: The superior and inferior crura bound the triangular fossa.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Triangular fossa of antihelix

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Depression between the superior and inferior crura of the antihelix.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Lies in the superior part of the auricle.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Tragus

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Small cartilaginous projection anterior to the external acoustic meatus.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Opposes the antitragus across the intertragic notch.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Antitragus

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Small cartilaginous prominence posteroinferior to the external acoustic meatus.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Opposes the tragus and is separated from it by the intertragic notch.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Intertragic notch

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Notch between the tragus and antitragus.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Opens inferiorly toward the lobule.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Lobule of auricle

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Soft inferior part of the auricle composed mainly of skin, fat and connective tissue without cartilage.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Lies inferior to the antitragus and helix.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: External acoustic meatus (external auditory canal)

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Extends from the auricle to the tympanic membrane; lateral part is cartilaginous and medial part bony.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Conducts sound waves toward the tympanic membrane.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Ends medially at the tympanic membrane.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Tympanic membrane (ear drum)

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Thin membrane separating the external acoustic meatus from the tympanic cavity.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Vibrates in response to sound and transmits movement to the ossicles via the malleus.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Handle of the malleus is attached to its medial surface.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Tympanic annulus

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Fibrocartilaginous ring anchoring most of the tympanic membrane to the tympanic sulcus.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Supports and fixes the tympanic membrane at its periphery.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Branches of the deep auricular artery

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Deep auricular artery usually arises from the first part of the maxillary artery.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Passes toward the external acoustic meatus and tympanic membrane.

cards.question: Supply
cards.answer: Supplies the external acoustic meatus and outer surface of the tympanic membrane.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Arcuate eminence of the petrous part of the temporal bone

cards.question: Bone
cards.answer: Petrous part of the temporal bone.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Elevation on the anterior surface of the petrous temporal bone, related approximately to the superior semicircular canal.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Pyramid of the petrous part of the temporal bone

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Dense pyramidal portion of temporal bone containing the middle and inner ear structures.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Projects anteromedially from the temporal bone toward the skull base.

cards.question: Contents
cards.answer: Contains the bony labyrinth, internal acoustic meatus and carotid canal.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Internal carotid artery

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Enters the carotid canal in the petrous temporal bone, turns anteromedially, then continues toward the cavernous sinus.

cards.question: Supply
cards.answer: Major arterial supply to the anterior cerebral circulation and orbit.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Closely related to the petrous temporal bone and middle ear region within the carotid canal.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Internal acoustic meatus

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Canal in the posterior surface of the petrous temporal bone.

cards.question: Contents
cards.answer: Facial nerve (CN VII), vestibulocochlear nerve (CN VIII) and labyrinthine vessels.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Opens from the posterior cranial fossa toward the inner ear.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Stylomastoid foramen

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Opening between styloid and mastoid processes of temporal bone.

cards.question: Contents
cards.answer: Facial nerve exits the skull here; stylomastoid artery also passes through.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Styloid process

cards.question: Bone
cards.answer: Temporal bone.

cards.question: Attachments
cards.answer: Gives attachment to styloglossus, stylohyoid and stylopharyngeus muscles and to stylohyoid and stylomandibular ligaments.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Slender projection extending inferiorly from temporal bone.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Jugular fossa

cards.question: Bone
cards.answer: Inferior surface of petrous temporal bone.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Accommodates the superior bulb of the internal jugular vein near the jugular foramen.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Internal carotid artery

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Traverses the carotid canal in the petrous temporal bone before entering the cavernous region.

cards.question: Supply
cards.answer: Supplies the brain and orbit through intracranial branches.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: The petrous internal carotid lies anterior to the middle ear and inner ear structures.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Tympanic cavity

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Air-filled cavity in the petrous temporal bone containing the auditory ossicles.

cards.question: Contents
cards.answer: Malleus, incus, stapes, tensor tympani, stapedius, chorda tympani and related nerves/vessels.

cards.question: Connections
cards.answer: Communicates anteriorly with the pharyngotympanic tube and posteriorly with mastoid air cells via the mastoid antrum.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Opening of the pharyngotympanic tube in the tympanic cavity

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Anterior wall of the tympanic cavity.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Connects the middle ear to the pharyngotympanic tube for pressure equalisation and drainage.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Opening of the pharyngotympanic tube in the nasopharynx

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Lateral wall of the nasopharynx.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Permits communication between the nasopharynx and middle ear to equalise pressure across the tympanic membrane.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Malleus

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Articulates with the incus at the incudomalleolar joint.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Transmits vibration from the tympanic membrane to the incus.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Handle is attached to the tympanic membrane.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Head of malleus
cards.label: 25a

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Lies in the epitympanic recess and articulates with the body of the incus.
cards.label: 25a

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Handle of malleus
cards.label: 25b

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Embedded in the tympanic membrane and transmits its vibration to the malleus.
cards.label: 25b

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Lateral process of malleus
cards.label: 25c

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Projects laterally toward the tympanic membrane and contributes to the malleolar folds.
cards.label: 25c

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Incus

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Articulates with malleus proximally and stapes distally via the lenticular process.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Transmits vibration from malleus to stapes.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Short limb of incus
cards.label: 26a

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Projects posteriorly and is supported in the fossa incudis.
cards.label: 26a

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Long limb of incus
cards.label: 26b

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Descends toward the stapes and ends in the lenticular process.
cards.label: 26b

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Stapes

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Articulates with the lenticular process of incus; base occupies the oval window.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Transmits ossicular vibration into the fluid of the inner ear at the oval window.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Head of stapes
cards.label: 27a

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Articulates with the lenticular process of the incus.
cards.label: 27a

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Anterior limb of stapes
cards.label: 27b

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Connects the stapes head to its base anteriorly.
cards.label: 27b

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Base of stapes
cards.label: 27c

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Fits into the oval window and transmits vibration to perilymph of the vestibule.
cards.label: 27c

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Lenticular process of incus

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Small terminal process of the long limb of incus that articulates with the head of the stapes.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Transfers vibration from incus to stapes.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Chorda tympani

cards.question: Roots
cards.answer: Branch of the facial nerve (CN VII).

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Crosses the tympanic cavity between the malleus and incus, exits via petrotympanic fissure and joins the lingual nerve.

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.answer: Carries taste from the anterior two-thirds of the tongue.

cards.question: Parasympathetic functions
cards.answer: Carries preganglionic fibres to the submandibular ganglion for submandibular and sublingual glands.

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: Causes loss or reduction of taste from the anterior two-thirds of the tongue and reduced submandibular and sublingual salivary secretion; general tongue sensation is preserved if the lingual nerve itself is intact.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Tensor tympani muscle

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Tenses the tympanic membrane by pulling the malleus medially, reducing excessive ossicular movement.

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Mandibular division of trigeminal nerve (V3), via nerve to medial pterygoid/tensor tympani branch.

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Cartilaginous pharyngotympanic tube and adjacent sphenoid/petrous temporal bone.

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Handle of malleus.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Vestibule

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Central part of the bony labyrinth between cochlea and semicircular canals.

cards.question: Contents
cards.answer: Contains the utricle and saccule of the membranous labyrinth.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Participates in static equilibrium and linear acceleration sensing through utricle and saccule.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Oval window

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Opening in the medial wall of the middle ear leading to the vestibule.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Occupied by the base of the stapes.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Receives mechanical vibration from the stapes and transmits it into inner-ear perilymph.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Cochlear promontory

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Rounded prominence on the medial wall of the tympanic cavity produced by the basal turn of the cochlea.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Lies between the oval and round window regions.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Round window

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Opening between middle ear and scala tympani, closed by the secondary tympanic membrane.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Allows pressure release/displacement of cochlear fluid when the stapes moves at the oval window.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Lateral semicircular canal

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Detects angular acceleration primarily in the horizontal plane.

cards.question: Connections
cards.answer: Opens into the vestibule at its ends, with an ampullary enlargement at one end.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Lateral bony ampulla
cards.label: 35a

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Enlarged bony end housing the ampulla of the lateral semicircular duct and its sensory crista.
cards.label: 35a

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Anterior semicircular canal

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Detects angular acceleration in a vertical plane.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Shares a common crus with the posterior semicircular canal before entering the vestibule.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Anterior bony ampulla
cards.label: 36b

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Enlarged end housing the ampulla of the anterior semicircular duct and its sensory crista.
cards.label: 36b

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Posterior semicircular canal

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Detects angular acceleration in a vertical plane.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Shares a common crus with the anterior semicircular canal.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Posterior bony ampulla
cards.label: 37c

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Enlarged end housing the ampulla of the posterior semicircular duct and its sensory crista.
cards.label: 37c

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Cochlea

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Spiral part of the bony labyrinth surrounding the modiolus and containing the cochlear duct between scala vestibuli and scala tympani.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Converts sound-induced mechanical vibrations into neural signals for hearing.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Basal turn (1st turn) of cochlea
cards.label: 38a

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Lowest and widest cochlear turn, closest to the oval and round windows.
cards.label: 38a

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Middle turn (2nd turn) of cochlea
cards.label: 38b

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Intermediate spiral turn between the basal and upper turns.
cards.label: 38b

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Upper turn (cupula) of cochlea
cards.label: 38c

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Apical region of the cochlear spiral near the helicotrema.
cards.label: 38c

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Osseous spiral lamina

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Thin shelf of bone projecting from the modiolus into the cochlear canal.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Partially divides the cochlear canal and supports the basilar membrane/cochlear partition.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Scala tympani

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Perilymph-filled compartment inferior to the cochlear duct.

cards.question: Connections
cards.answer: Communicates with scala vestibuli at the helicotrema and ends at the round window.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Conducts pressure waves through perilymph toward the round window.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Scala vestibuli

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Perilymph-filled compartment superior to the cochlear duct.

cards.question: Connections
cards.answer: Begins at the vestibule near the oval window and communicates with scala tympani at the helicotrema.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Conducts pressure waves entering from the stapes/oval window through the cochlea.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Saccule

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Membranous labyrinth structure within the vestibule, closer to the cochlea.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Detects linear acceleration, particularly in the vertical plane, and head position relative to gravity.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Utricle

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Membranous labyrinth structure within the vestibule, connected to the semicircular ducts.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Detects linear acceleration mainly in the horizontal plane and static head position.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Ampulla of semicircular duct

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Dilated end of a semicircular duct containing the crista ampullaris.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Detects angular acceleration through movement of endolymph deflecting the cupula over sensory hair cells.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Vestibulocochlear nerve (CN VIII)

cards.question: Roots
cards.answer: Vestibular and cochlear divisions from the inner ear.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Passes through the internal acoustic meatus and enters the brainstem at the cerebellopontine angle.

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.answer: Hearing and balance.

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: Can cause sensorineural hearing loss, tinnitus, vertigo and imbalance.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Vestibular branch of the vestibulocochlear nerve

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Carries afferents from utricle, saccule and semicircular ducts through the internal acoustic meatus to vestibular nuclei/cerebellum.

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.answer: Conveys information about head position, linear acceleration and angular acceleration.

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: Dysfunction can cause vertigo, imbalance and abnormal vestibulo-ocular reflexes.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Cochlear branch of the vestibulocochlear nerve

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Carries auditory afferents from spiral ganglion/cochlea through the internal acoustic meatus to cochlear nuclei.

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.answer: Hearing.

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: Damage causes ipsilateral sensorineural hearing loss.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Facial canal containing the facial nerve (CN VII)

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Bony canal in the temporal bone carrying CN VII from the internal acoustic meatus to the stylomastoid foramen.

cards.question: Contents
cards.answer: Facial nerve and associated vessels.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Runs in close relation to the middle and inner ear; includes labyrinthine, tympanic and mastoid segments.

cards.question: Clinical relevance
cards.answer: Facial nerve can be affected by temporal bone disease, inflammation or fracture along the canal.
